newsitem.title: FINLAND: Finland world leader in cellular penetration - Tele.
newsitem.headline: Finland world leader in cellular penetration - Tele.

text.p: Finland now has the world's highest mobile phone penetration, a Telecom Finland spokesman said on Friday.
By December last year, Finland had overtaken Norway and Sweden, he told Reuters, referring to a report published by Financial Times Mobile Communications on January 9.

The report showed the situation on December 1 when Finnish subscribers were 28.1 percent of the population compared to Sweden's 27.8 percent and Norway's 26.8 percent. In December 1995, Norway was first at 22.8 percent, Sweden second at 22.7 percent and Finland third at 19.9 percent, the spokesman said.
He said penetration had increased further in December.

Daily Hufvudstadsbladet on Friday quoted another official at state-owned Telecom Finland as saying that slower penetration growth in Sweden and Norway may be due to the countries' operators' strategy to subsidise handsets.
